_comment: ORIGINAL walk-on, no proper name (the Peddler/gate_guard precedent for unnamed civic-texture NPCs). Hosted by market_stallkeeper (pallass_market). Carries the race-variant texture pair: the Human 'don't see many of you up this tier' friction / the Drake second-queue insider line; base line self-sufficient for gnoll/fallback.

hub.speaker: Market-Tier Local
hub.text: Busy morning for the stalls. Mind the queues -- they move faster than they look.

text_variants._comment: Race-variant line set: Human friction. PLACEHOLDER copy, D-phase replaces.
text_variants.text: Don't see many of you up this tier. Nothing personal in the look -- just not a common one.

text_variants._comment: Race-variant line set: Drake assumed-local. PLACEHOLDER copy, D-phase replaces.
text_variants.text: You'll want the second queue -- the first one's for out-of-towners. You know how it is.

options._comment: Class-foundation pass R5 (2026-07-12): the Pallass sell surface -- this ORIGINAL walk-on (hosted by market_stallkeeper, pallass_market) doubles as 'the Pallass market clerk-adjacent stallkeeper' (the plan's own framing -- adjacent to tier_clerk_market's checkpoint, a casual stall rather than the civic fee, so deliberately NOT no_haggle: nothing in this NPC's own voice claims a posted-price policy the way the clerk's or Krshia's own lines do). Generalized WIShop.build_sell_graph (shop.gd's own doc comment) via open_sell_picker's vendor-id'd value.
options.text: Anything on you worth my coin?
